header.title: About us & Contacts
header.subtitle: Aikido club Mariánské Lázně – BUDO CLUB

aboutP1: We are a small aikido club in Mariánské Lázně operating under the name BUDO CLUB. We teach aikido for children, teenagers, and adults. Our goal is to spread the philosophy of aikido – developing both body and mind, and the ability to defend oneself without violence.
aboutP2: The club is non-profit and open to everyone regardless of age, gender, or prior martial arts experience.
